scripts.text:
[Tony]
I'm Tony, the Bullet Dealer.
Come to me whenever you're
short on ammo. Just bring me
the materials, and I'll make
you the bullets you need.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
我是子彈商人托尼。
缺彈藥了就來找我。
只要帶齊材料，我就能幫你製作需要的子彈。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey, I'm Tony. I'm in
charge of distributing
and making bullets for
Gunslingers. It's just
how our guild likes
to do things.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，我是托尼。
我負責為神槍手分發和製作子彈。
這就是我們公會的做事方式。

scripts.text: Poison Sphere
scripts.translation: 毒球

scripts.text: Flare Sphere
scripts.translation: 火球

scripts.text: Lighting Sphere
scripts.translation: 雷球

scripts.text: Blind Sphere
scripts.translation: 盲球

scripts.text: Freezing Sphere
scripts.translation: 冰球

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Tony]
For every set of
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
每組需要：

scripts.text:
{0} {1},
you must give me
1 Emveretarcon,
1 Phracon, and
scripts.translation:
{0} {1}，
還需要交給我
1個強化武器金屬-級數二、
1個強化武器金屬-級數一，以及

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Remember that I can give
a maximum of 500 sets of
30 bullets at a time. Please
enter the number of bullet sets
that you'd like. If you want to
cancel, then just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
記住，每組有30發子彈，一次最多兌換500組。
請輸入你要兌換的組數。
若要取消，請輸入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey, I can't give you
that many bullets. Don't
forget to enter a number
that's no higher than 500
if you want to trade your
items for some bullets.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，一次可換不了那麼多子彈。
要用材料兌換子彈，請輸入不超過500的數量。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Huh. It looks like you
don't have enough materials
for that many bullets. Well,
it's no problem. Just come
back after gathering everything
that you need, okay?
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嗯，看來你的材料不夠，換不了那麼多子彈。
沒關係，等材料收齊了再來吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Eh? Your Inventory doesn't
have enough space for this
many bullets. Come back later
after you make more space
available. Try putting some of
your things into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
咦？你的物品欄放不下這麼多子彈。
先騰出些空間再來吧。
可以把一些東西存進卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Great, everything seems
to be in order. Let me take
these materials, and here are
your bullets. It's a pleasure
to do business with you~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
很好，材料都齊了。
材料我收下了，這是你的子彈。
合作愉快~
